tests.title: Valida contraseña débil "hola" — pasa 0..2/7
tests.fullTitle: PasswordStrength Component Valida contraseña débil "hola" — pasa 0..2/7
tests.code:
const pwd = 'hola'
let score = 0
if (pwd.length >= 6) score++
if (/[a-z]/.test(pwd)) score++
if (/[A-Z]/.test(pwd)) score++
if (/\d/.test(pwd)) score++
if (/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/.test(pwd)) score++
if (/\s/.test(pwd)) score++
if (/123|abc|qwerty|password/i.test(pwd)) score++
expect(score).to.be.lessThan(3)

tests.code:
const pwd = 'Abcd1234!'
let score = 0
if (pwd.length >= 6) score++
if (/[a-z]/.test(pwd)) score++
if (/[A-Z]/.test(pwd)) score++
if (/\d/.test(pwd)) score++
if (/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/.test(pwd)) score++
if (/\s/.test(pwd)) score++
if (/123|abc|qwerty|password/i.test(pwd)) score++
expect(score).to.be.at.least(5)
